pick.name: Google Chrome
pick.what: Mainstream Chromium browser with profiles and the widest extension support
pick.why: Largest extension ecosystem; Claude in Chrome works in Chrome only
pick.free_limits: Free; Claude in Chrome needs a paid Claude plan

alts.name: Zen Browser
alts.what: Firefox-based browser with Arc-style workspaces and vertical tabs
alts.why: Best Arc-style UX; loses Chrome-only extensions

alts.name: Brave
alts.why: Ad-blocking by default; Claude in Chrome not supported

candidates.name: Dia (Atlassian)
candidates.verdict: Arc successor; Mac first, Windows early build reported Oct 2026, unverified on vendor site

candidates.name: Arc
candidates.verdict: Maintenance/sunsetting; do not adopt (reported stops working on Windows 2026-12-22)

candidates.name: Edge / Safari / Firefox
candidates.verdict: Fine daily drivers, no Claude in Chrome

candidates.name: BrowserOS
candidates.verdict: Open-source agentic Chromium; agent browser, not daily driver

decision: Chrome is the safest default: every extension works and Claude in Chrome runs there. Use separate profiles for work and personal identities. Pick Zen if you want Arc-like workspaces and can live without Chrome-only extensions.
details: Anthropic says Claude in Chrome is 'still risky'; keep it out of profiles holding sensitive logins.

os_notes.macOS: Chrome, Zen or Safari; Dia is Mac-first.
os_notes.Linux: Chrome or Brave; Zen via Flatpak/AppImage.

verify.note: Shallow check; Linux apt needs Google's repo or the .deb from google.com/chrome.
